chapters.title: Shape your page
chapters.description: Choose a theme in Design studio and see it in the live preview. Undo and redo draft changes, then publish when you are ready.

chapters.title: Organize your links
chapters.description: Search and sort your dashboard without changing the public page order. Open More link tools to review upcoming publishing dates.

chapters.title: Make it worth a visit
chapters.description: Explore the published sample page. Save a link for later, open the browser-local reading list, and expand an FAQ answer.

chapters.title: Share with a scan
chapters.description: Open the profile’s QR share kit. Download an SVG that you can reuse on a poster, business card, or packaging. PNG downloads are available too.
